questions.prompt: The North Wing opens at 09:00 and closes at 17:00. A reservation must end at least 30 minutes before closing. The maximum duration is 4 hours. Which 09:00 reservation is valid?
questions.explanation: The 30-minute buffer requires ending by 16:30, and the 4-hour limit applies. Only option A satisfies both: 09:00 to 13:00 is exactly 4 hours and ends before 16:30.

questions.prompt: The East Gallery opens at 10:00 and closes at 18:00. Reservations over 3 hours require 24-hour advance notice. A group submits a request at 09:00 today for tomorrow. Which reservation is accepted?
questions.explanation: The 24-hour notice is satisfied for tomorrow. The 4-hour reservation in option C fits within 10:00-18:00 and has proper notice. Option B violates the closing time (no buffer mentioned but 18:00 is exact closing), and D exceeds 3 hours without the explicit notice being for a long reservation.

questions.prompt: Room A and Room B share a single attendant. A booking in Room A from 09:00-12:00 blocks Room B during that window. Room B opens at 08:00 and closes at 16:00. When can Room B be reserved for 2 hours?
questions.explanation: Room B is blocked 09:00-12:00 due to Room A's booking. A 2-hour reservation must avoid this window. Option D (12:00-14:00) starts exactly when the block ends and fits within 08:00-16:00.

questions.prompt: The Special Exhibit opens at 13:00. Morning slots (before 13:00) are reserved for members only; afternoon slots require a guide fee of $50. A non-member arrives at 12:30 wanting the earliest possible slot. What applies?
choices: Can enter at 12:30 with no fee
Must wait until 13:00 with no fee
questions.explanation: As a non-member, morning slots are unavailable. The earliest possible is 13:00, which triggers the afternoon guide fee requirement. Option A correctly combines both constraints.

questions.prompt: The Rotunda has consecutive 90-minute slots starting at 09:00. A reservation can span multiple slots if continuous. The last slot must start by 16:30. Which reservation is impossible?
questions.explanation: Slots are 09:00-10:30, 10:30-12:00, 12:00-13:30, 13:30-15:00, 15:00-16:30, 16:30-18:00. Option C (15:00-17:30) requires a slot starting at 16:30 to continue, but 16:30-18:00 is only 90 minutes; 15:00-17:30 is 150 minutes needing a non-existent 15:00-16:30 plus 16:30-18:00, but 15:00-16:30 exists. Rechecking: 15:00-16:30 and 16:30-18:00 gives exactly 15:00-18:00, not 17:30. Actually 15:00-17:30 cannot be formed from consecutive 90-minute slots. The last slot starts at 16:30, so 16:30-18:00 is valid. Option C's end time 17:30 doesn't align with slot boundaries.

questions.prompt: The Sapphire Wing opens at 09:00 and closes at 17:00. A reservation must end at least 30 minutes before closing. The maximum duration is 4 hours. Which reservation is valid?
questions.explanation: The wing closes at 17:00, so reservations must end by 16:30. The 4-hour limit means 09:00-14:00 exceeds duration. 13:00-17:00 ends at closing time, violating the 30-minute buffer. 12:30-16:45 ends after 16:30. Only 10:00-14:00 fits both constraints.

questions.prompt: The Jade Gallery accepts reservations from 08:00 to 20:00. Priority members may book any slot. Standard members may only book slots starting at or after 12:00. Which reservation is valid for a standard member?
questions.explanation: Standard members are restricted to slots starting at or after 12:00. 08:00-10:00 starts too early. 11:30-13:30 starts before 12:00. 20:00-22:00 exceeds the gallery's 20:00 closing. Only 12:00-14:00 satisfies the standard member rule and operates within hours.

questions.prompt: The Amber Hall operates 10:00-18:00. If a reservation starts before 14:00, it may last up to 3 hours. If it starts at or after 14:00, it may last up to 2 hours. Which reservation is valid?
questions.explanation: Starting before 14:00 allows 3 hours maximum; 11:00-14:30 exceeds this. Starting at or after 14:00 allows 2 hours maximum; 14:00-16:30 exceeds this, and 15:00-17:30 also exceeds this. 13:00-16:00 is exactly 3 hours, permitted for pre-14:00 starts.

questions.prompt: The Ruby Room opens at 09:00. Existing reservations take precedence: a new reservation is rejected if it overlaps any confirmed reservation. Confirmed: 10:00-12:00 and 14:00-16:00. Which new reservation is accepted?
questions.explanation: 11:00-13:00 overlaps 10:00-12:00. 13:00-15:00 overlaps 14:00-16:00. 15:00-17:00 overlaps 14:00-16:00. 12:00-14:00 touches but does not overlap either confirmed reservation, so it is accepted.

questions.prompt: The Onyx Chamber runs 08:00-22:00. Reservations require 15-minute setup before the public start time. Cleanup requires 15 minutes after the public end. Public-facing time is limited to 5 hours maximum. Which reservation is valid?
questions.explanation: Public time is limited to 5 hours. Option A has 6 hours public time. Option C starts setup at 08:00 but chamber opens at 08:00, so setup cannot begin then. Option D has 5 hours 15 minutes public time. Option B has 3 hours 45 minutes public time, proper setup/cleanup timing, and fits within hours.
